implemented_evidence: Actual Tf/ExtGState Font references are distinct from merely inventoried resources and text-showing uses. Unreferenced named fonts are exempt from applicable font clauses; incomplete usage proofs remain notVerified. Undefined/free references resolve null, and null DescendantFonts is reported as a required FontDictionaryModel violation rather than a valid empty font.

Existing contextual text/resource inventory remains unchanged: actual page/Form/Pattern/AP/Type3/SMask font uses, lexical unused-container evidence, ActualText through marked content and StructTreeRoot Pg/Stm/MCID; completeness guards retained.

CFF1 standard strings391, Expert charset166, ExpertSubset charset87 and ExpertEncoding256 are factual tables transcribed independently from Adobe5176 AppendicesA–C. Charset bounds, duplicate SID/CID and undefined SID checks apply; parsed CFF names/GID precede native synthetic names.

CFF width contexts inventory every FDArray DICT, every FDSelect0/3 selector/range/sentinel, each Private DICT bounds and every associated LocalSubrs INDEX before glyph lookup. defaultWidthX/nominalWidthX and actual biased local/global calls use the selected FD, including global-to-local calls. Valid bytes in FD0 do not conceal malformed Private/Subrs or selectors in FD1. FD FontMatrix composition remains explicit notVerified; no guessed unit multiplication.

SFNT model checks inspect actual table bounds/overlap, head magic/indexToLocFormat, TrueType maxp1.0 length, all loca offsets and every glyph header, simple endpoints/flags/coordinate byte counts, composite GID bounds/transforms/cycles/maxp totals; malformed structures produce explicit model failures independently of CGFont acceptance.

Actual cmap0/2/4/6/8/10/12/13/14 bodies are bounded and structurally checked. cmap2 handles mixed-byte subheaders and relative glyph offsets; cmap8 converts supplementary Unicode scalars to packed UTF16 surrogate units, separately from exact raw encoded-code lookup, according to Microsoft/Apple cmap8 and UnicodeD91. Full-repertoire cmap tables take precedence over BMP tables. cmap14 remains supplemental with selector/scalar/offset/order/GID/disjoint-partition checks. This does not claim full variation shaping or all encoding semantics.

TrueType glyph/fpgm/prep instruction token boundaries and PUSH payload lengths are checked. Valid token boundaries never imply hinting execution; FontBytecodeModel remains notVerified when bytecode semantics are unproved. Resource budgets and incomplete scans remain notVerified.

Horizontal advances use hmtx or actual Type1/CFF program widths against PDF Widths/W/DW. Per ISO32000-1§9.2.4 and§9.9, WMode1 does not create an equality obligation between W2/DW2 and vmtx/VORG. W2/DW2 grammar, finite numeric values and CID ranges are checked separately for vertical CID fonts. TrueType ignores VORG; no vertical origins are invented.

Existing pinned215-item original Adobe data and per-file hash validation retained. Integrity regression covers forged manifest+item hash, altered/missing AGL and altered CMap before parsing; runtime remains Apple frameworks/custom Swift and offline reference data only.

Bounded Type2 program audit executes deterministic numeric/stack/transient/conditional operations, exact local/global subroutine contexts, path and flex operand cardinalities, initial width consumption, moveto-before-path, stem declaration boundaries, mask byte consumption/padding bits, return/endchar and truncated tokens. Private delta arrays and scalar cardinalities are checked independently of CGFont acceptance. Proved malformed structures fail; unsupported legacy/random/undefined values, resource/nesting/stem budgets and cancellation remain notVerified. Outline geometry and rasterizer hint execution are not certified.

TrueType simple-glyph packed flags and repeated flags now decode original cumulative x/y deltas with exact signed-short and signed-byte rules, comparing all on/off-curve control points to the declared bounding rectangle. Only default original coordinates are checked; variable instances and hinted geometry are not inferred. Nonzero reserved simple bit7 and composite bits13-15 are structural issues.

Composite point arguments are decoded as unsigned uint8/uint16, independently of signed XY offsets. The first component must use XY positioning. Child index bounds include all four permitted phantom points; parent indices are rejected only beyond the necessary complete-parent count+4 bound. An intermediate parent numbering not independently proved remains notVerified. Nested component summaries use expanded original point/contour counts and maxp maxima, with cycle detection, memoization, cancellation, depth and operation budgets. Incomplete children never invent small/zero point counts for failure decisions.

Edition/applicability corrections: every negative numberOfContours selects composite (minus1 is recommended only); WE_HAVE_INSTRUCTIONS on any component is honored; modern simple bit6 overlap is accepted; historical composite bit4 overlap is explicitly notVerified rather than rejected, because Apple AAT documents old assignments and ignored scaler behavior. These choices are validated on actual native Arial and corpus font bytes, not on CGFont acceptance.

Budget/cancellation hardening: SFNT glyf point/contour passes, component graph and instruction token walks have charged work, cancellation at repeated boundaries and explicit unknown outcomes; cancelled fpgm/prep or component traversal never becomes a malformed-font failure. Unchecked glyphs remain incomplete. This does not provide a complete TrueType VM or proof for every unrelated SFNT table.
remaining_gaps: No complete TrueType hinting virtual machine: stack/control flow, FDEF/IDEF, CVT/storage/zones, size-dependent geometry and every extension are not proven by PUSH lexical checks.

No complete Type1/PostScript or Type2 rasterizer/path-geometry proof. Type2 token/stack/deterministic arithmetic/subroutine/path-arity/mask structure is now checked, but outline geometry, hint-zone ordering/overlap semantics, full Private value semantics, seac component/nesting geometry, random/undefined operations and unreachable/unused subroutine programs remain unresolved. Reserved multi-master/store/load legacy operations remain unknown rather than edition-blind false failures.

FD FontMatrix composition with Top FontMatrix is still not proven from the retrieved primary specifications; no guessed multiplication is used. The fixed font-provided hmtx/native-byte widths remain distinct evidence from independent raw CFF declared-width parsing.

cmap8 supplementary Unicode conversion is implemented using UTF16 pairs; raw non-Unicode mixed encodings remain a distinct API. Full variation shaping, CFF2/variable outlines and variation metric stores remain unmodeled. Some font-specific built-in encodings and complete MacExpertEncoding remain unresolved.

SFNT checks cover explicit binary structures listed above, not all font tables, checksums, OpenType shaping/layout or mathematical outline/hint validity. No absent optional table or fullOpenType packaging assumption is introduced as a blanket PDF-subset failure.
Full ISO19005 and normative-reference completeness remains unproven. Global scopeGaps must remain. Local structural/model passes never remove the global completeness gate.

Composite attachment positions after local transforms, child hinting, grid-fitting and phantom-point metric adjustments remain unexecuted. Complete-parent count+4 is only a necessary index bound; uncertain phantom numbering during intermediate incorporation is notVerified, not guessed. Composite geometric bounding boxes and exact mathematical outline validity are not proven.

Historical composite bit4 is documented as ignored by Apple but reserved in current OpenType prose; edition applicability is not proven, so it prevents a structural-model pass rather than causing a false failure. Modern overlap flags do not prove actual intersection topology.
